name: tc-national-health-insurance
description: Turks and Caicos National Health Insurance Plan contribution reference checked for 2026. Covers ordinary employee and employer shares, the monthly minimum, earnings ceilings, allowance treatment, multiple employments and reporting deadlines. Uses the official consolidated National Health Insurance Ordinance and contribution regulations, with worked payroll examples and a distinction between statutory payment timing and the Board’s earlier submission date. Use after employment coverage is established. Keeps national health insurance separate from national insurance. Later amendments, irregular periods, self-employed concessions and benefit eligibility need separate review. This source-cited draft has not received independent accountant attestation.
